module.name: context-menu
module.title: ContextMenu
module.description: The ContextMenu renderer and its options.

ui.name: context-menu
ui.summary: Renders a region whose commands are reachable by right-click and by an explicit trigger.
ui.guidance: The trigger is a real DropdownMenu, so the keyboard path is the same well-tested one every other menu uses; right-click is the addition, not the mechanism.
ui.keyboard: Right-click opens the menu, and its trigger carries the standard menu keys: Escape closes, ArrowUp/ArrowDown and Home/End move between commands, and a printable character jumps to the next matching one.
